about: ADR 0855 P5 merge gate: GitHub pull requests (title, description, unified diff) against a team ledger. `expect: flag` = the change departs from the ledger with NO recorded decision authorizing it (must yield >= 1 unexplained finding); `expect: pass` = the change follows the ledger, or departs only where a recorded decision chose it (must yield 0 unexplained). Same bar as the run fixture: >= 0.9 flagged AND <= 0.1 false flags (scripts/eval-drift-check.mts test/fixtures/drift-check-pr-eval.json).
